articles.summary: New dog parent study explores challenges dog parents face as return to office approaches NEW YORK, September 28, 2021 – The Original BARK Company (NYSE: BARK) (“BARK”), the company behind BarkBox, today revealed findings from a new survey of American dog parents on how their relationships with their dogs have grown, as
articles.title: BARK Survey Reveals 7 in 10 Dog Parents Will Miss Their Dog When They Return to Work; Far Fewer Will Miss Their Spouse or Children
